The '''Invader AA-9''' was a model of assault [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] manufactured by [[Mekuun Corporation/Legends|Mekuun Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was used for battlefield close air support and squad insertion missions. The [[Invader AA-9s Assault Airspeeder|AA-9s]] was a stealthier version of the airspeeder.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
